surfaces.summary: Provides the runtime.database capability: the selected driver, its Knex client and a transaction manager.
Migrates the installed package graph and runs one explicit app-owned seed operation without a CLI or persistent setup record.
Builds fixed-dialect Knex migration configuration and discovers immutable migrations directly from installed JSKIT packages.
Adds a single-column foreign key only when it is missing, refusing rows without a parent, for constraints migrations on fresh and already-migrated databases.

Gives each test file or browser worker running at once its own disposable copy of TEST_DB_NAME or BROWSER_TEST_DB_NAME, restored from a schema snapshot keyed by the migrations' names and contents (MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL), and counts the statements a piece of work sends, for query-count guards.
Exports shared repository helpers (transactions, record ids, JSON columns, visibility, duplicate-entry detection and date/time serialization).
Types of the runtime.database capability and of the runtime.database.driver contract every driver package implements, for features that require them.
